Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

Benefícios

  • LIGADO EM VOCÊ: Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto.
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendidas + Kit nascimento para recém-mamães e recém-papais.
  • Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na AUTOMOB , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar para os filhos da nossa gente.
  • Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar.
  • Pela Universidade AUTOMOB , a nossa gente aprende e potencializa seu desenvolvimento profissional, tornando cada um(a) protagonista de sua carreira.
  • Reconhecemos e valorizamos a nossa gente veterana que completa anos de casa. Quem possui mais de 15 anos , ainda tem um evento mega especial.
  • Cantinho da Mamãe: O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno. No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.

Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias.

O sonho que começou em 1995 com a primeira Concessionária Volkswagen, ganhou força e se transformou no maior e mais diversificado grupo de Concessionárias do Brasil.

Nossa devoção em servir é parte da nossa cultura, temos um time altamente capacitado e que compartilha dos mesmos valores: GENTE, CLIENTE, SIMPLICIDADE, ATITUDE DE DONO, SUSTENTABILIDADE E LUCRO.

Em 2021 iniciamos nosso processo de consolidação com a criação da AUTOMOB, mas foi em 2024 que reunimos todas as empresas e operações de Concessionárias em uma só companhia. Atualmente temos mais de 200 lojas espalhadas por 13 estados brasileiros, e contamos com um time de quase 7000 funcionários.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Executar métodos e técnicas fonoaudiológicas afim de auxiliar no desenvolvimento da fala, escrita e correções das funções estomatognáticas, monitorar e aperfeiçoar os aspectos fonoaudiológicos envolvidos nos distúrbios da audição, motricidade ou facial e incentivo ao aleitamento materno.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Fonoaudiologia

Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Audiologia, Linguagem, Motricidade Orofacial, Saúde Coletiva, Disfagia, Fonoaudiologia

Neurofuncional, Gerontologia ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde/ Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Fonoaudiólogo.

CHIEF ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER

Place of Assignment: National Resource and Logistics Management Bureau

CSC-PRESCRIBED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master’s Degree or Certificate in Leadership and Management from the CSC

Training: Forty (40) hours of supervisory/management learning and development intervention

Experience: Four (4) years of supervisory/management experience

Eligibility: Career Service (Professional); Second Level Eligibility

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master’s Degree preferably in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Office/Business Administration, Public Administration, Community Development, Economics, Sociology, Human Resource Management and/or Accounting

Training: At least 48 hours of training on supervisory/management related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality assurance/control, volunteers’ deployment, human resource, procurement processes, planning, monitoring and evaluation, budget preparation, and capacity building

Experience: At least five (5) years’ experience on supervisory / management related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment. Must also have experience in disaster operations

Eligibility: Career Service (Professional); Second Level Eligibility

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Thorough understanding of RA 10121: Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act
  • Must have enough knowledge regarding government laws and processes
  • Above average knowledge on use of MS Office
  • Great attention to details
  • Above average knowledge in planning/organizing/accounting/monitoring and evaluation
  • Above average knowledge on the management of warehouse/logistics/production/donation facilitation/processing/monitoring/financial and quality control standard setting / institutionalization of volunteers’ assistance
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to work harmoniously, competently and effectively under pressure

JOB DESCRIPTION

Under direction and with substantial latitude for independent judgment, serves as the Division Chief and acts as the head of the Resource Management Division engaged in varied work ranging from routine to difficult and special work requiring training and moderate experiences or lower training but considerable experience and thorough knowledge pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.

FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Directs, supervises, coordinates the review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidelines, systems and processes pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  2. Implements policies / mechanisms to ensure transparency and efficiency of procedures in the receipt, inventory, valuation, utilization and reporting of procured and donated items.
  3. Recommends and supervises personnel that shall be assigned to assist in the donation facilitation in the “one‑stop‑shop” to be established by the government in times of disasters/calamities.
  4. Supervises the receipt, warehousing, processing, production/packing/repacking and releasing of procured and donated goods as allocated by the Disaster Response Management Bureau.
  5. Supervises the deployment of volunteers during the production/repacking of relief items in NROC and other production /repacking hubs that may be established/identified as extension of NROC during disaster relief operations.
  6. Coordinates the establishment of institutional partnership with other government agencies, non‑government organizations, private entities, people’s organizations, etc., for logistical support in the transport of FFPs to FOs / disaster‑affected areas / designated delivery sites consistent with the relief allocation plan and volunteer assistance during disaster operations at NROC.
  7. Monitors the compliance of DSWD Disaster Response Centers and Field Office on the required number and type of relief items for stockpiling and prepositioning at any given time.
  8. Submits reports and documentation pertaining to inventory management and recommends appropriate actions, policy improvement and submits recommendations necessary.
  9. Supervises the implementation of the relief allocation plan submitted by Disaster Response Management Group in a timely manner.
  10. Supervises the integration/consolidation of programs, activities and projects of NRLMB in the Work and Financial Plan which include targets, schedules and performance metrics.
  11. Submits outputs of subordinates against performance standards and provides inputs to the Head of NRLMB in rating the performance of subordinates and in identifying performance gaps and proposed staff development interventions.
  12. Resolves staff concerns and raises issues to the Head of NRLMB when beyond authority.
  13. Updates the Head of NRLMB on the status of its deliverables/tasks regularly.
  14. Provides supervisory and consultative assistance/services to the Head of NRLMB, partner/stakeholders and FOs and DRCs counterpart to address the challenges encountered on logistics and production in the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  15. Attends meetings, conferences and other activities on behalf of the Head of NRLMB as delegated.
  16. Acts as resource person during seminars/training/workshops related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment, as requested.
  17. Assures functions as the Head of NRLMB if the Head is on official travel/business or on leave of absence or other analogous circumstances resulting in inability to perform the duties of the position.
  18. Performs other tasks as may be required by the Head of NRLMB.

JOB OUTPUTS

  1. Enhanced policies, guidelines and procedures relative to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  2. Memorandum of Agreement with GOs, NGOs, POs, PAs, etc., relative to logistics and production during disaster operations.
  3. Proposed Operations and Contingency Plan.
  4. Consolidated Operations Reports (quarterly, semesterly and annually) of NRLMB.
  5. Updates, Memoranda and other office communications.
  6. Technical assistance to DRCs, FOs, LGUs, intermediaries and stakeholders.

CRITERIA FOR EVALUATION

Education: 25%

Training: 10%

Experience: 25%

IQT: 10%

Technical Exam: 15%

Interview: 10%

Performance Review: 5%

Total: 100%

INITIAL SHORTLISTING

Obtain 80% of the maximum total score or 48 points in Education, Training, and Experience (ETE).

FINAL SHORTLISTING

Top five (5) highest rating but overall rating should not be less than 85%.

APPLY NOW

Na Mills, acreditamos que construir vai muito além do nosso modelo de negócio. É sobre criar conexões, gerar oportunidades e transformar histórias com impacto real.

Com mais de 72 anos de história, somos referência nacional em locação de plataformas elevatórias, máquinas pesadas (linha amarela e caminhões), compressores, geradores de energia, empilhadeiras, transpaleteiras, rebocadores e, equipamentos de formas e escoramentos. Nossa cultura valoriza o respeito, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento de pessoas e a inovação. Aqui, trabalhamos em um ambiente que promove o crescimento, a segurança e o bem-estar de todos, onde cada pessoa é parte essencial para o nosso sucesso.

Gênero, geração e cultura não representam barreiras no que diz respeito ao conhecimento, talentos e habilidades. A diversidade faz parte da nossa construção diária, e sabemos que equipes plurais geram mais criatividade, inovação e resultados.

Estamos em construção. Faça parte dessa jornada e venha contribuir para uma Mills mais diversa, sustentável, inovadora e cheia de oportunidades.

Assegurando que os dados sejam coletados de maneira eficiente, armazenados com segurança e disponibilizados para análise e tomada de decisões estratégicas.

  • Integrar dados de várias fontes em um único ambiente de dados, garantindo a consistência e a integridade dos dados;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados que automatizem a transferência e transformação de dados de maneira eficiente;
  • Implementar medidas de segurança para proteger os dados contra acessos não autorizados e vazamentos;
  • Colaborar para fornecer conjuntos de dados prontos para análise;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e otimizar a escalabilidade e a eficiência;
  • Manter documentação completa e atualizada de processos, fluxos de dados e arquitetura de sistemas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior Completo;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias, soluções e conceitos de Big Data;
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de versionamento de código Git;
  • Entendimento do ciclo de vida dos dados e conceitos como linhagem, governança, privacidade, retenção, anonimização, etc.;
  • Espírito colaborativo com equipes de Ciência de dados e Analytics, equipe de negócios para entender e atender às necessidades de dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, compartilhamento proativo e busca de contexto para colaborar com diferentes equipes.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL para processar grandes volumes de dados, garantindo a qualidade e a integridade das informações;
  • Proficiência em Python;
  • Conhecimento dos recursos de nuvem GCP: Storage Transfer Service, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, DataFlow, BigQuery, Dataplex, Cloud Computer;
  • Experiência com Apache Airflow ou outras ferramentas para fluxos de trabalho de dados;
  • Experiência com soluções de armazenamento em colunas e/ou conceitos de data lakehouse;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de CI/CD, infraestrutura como código (Terraform), observabilidade, entre outras;
  • Entendimento de como a otimização funciona em vários cenários e pode ser melhorada, como desempenho de consulta, escalabilidade de serviço e gerenciamento de cluster;
  • Curiosidade sobre tecnologias em rápida evolução no domínio da engenharia de dados e está ansioso para aprender e dominá-las, trazendo um impacto significativo para nossa equipe.

Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.  Benefits and Perks  Flexible working arrangements.  Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.  Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.  Equal opportunity employment.  Health and wellbeing programmes.  Collaborative work with a truly global team. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.  In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more. title: Network security specialist, enterprise browser
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We AreThis role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your CareerYou will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.
Your ImpactWin new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and account strategies to increase our sales penetration of Enterprise Browser into our top accounts
Engage with customers to identify and progress opportunities whilst delivering subject matter expertise on Enterprise Browser solutions
Qualify and progress leads and opportunities through the sales cycle to closure
Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
Help build and project Palo Alto Networks positionQualifications
Your Experience4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniquesAdditional Information
The TeamPalo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our CommitmentWe’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

DIFERENCIAIS

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES  
 
Analisar documentos, qualificações, estruturas societárias e padrões de governança corporativa.
Construir políticas, normativas, documentos e fluxos operacionais.
Usar automação de processos e relatórios pra construção de fluxos e procedimentos operacionais.
Implementar controles regulatórios e alinhados com frameworks reconhecidos no mercado.
Desenvolver conteúdo para programas e iniciativas abrangentes de conscientização.
Suportar processos de Auditoria Interna com foco regulatório.
Implementar e monitorar planos de ação e planos de auditoria.
Desenvolver e manter atualizados os programas de Compliance.
Implementar políticas de Compliance, tais como: Anticorrupção, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Combate ao Terrorismo, Ética e Conduta, Due Diligence com terceiros, entre outras.
Gerir riscos, identificando proativamente riscos legais e regulatórios e desenvolvendo estratégias de mitigação de impacto.
Mapear processos/procedimentos para Controles Internos de PLD (Prevenção a Lavagem de Dinheiro).
Monitorar cenário regulatório.  
FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS
Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.
No FTR, utilizamos o Direito como uma ferramenta para negócios e mitigação de riscos.
 
Com escritórios no RJ e SP, atuação full service e multidisciplinar (desde o consultivo ao contencioso), o FTR tem como um dos seus principais pilares a inovação constante e caracteriza-se por uma dinâmica de trabalho extremamente ágil, estrutura horizontal e acesso direto aos sócios, permitindo um crescimento profissional rápido, multidisciplinar e integrado.
Há anos, o FTR impulsiona e relaciona-se com diversas startups e empresas de inovação, para utilizar a inteligência dos dados em otimização de eficiência e mitigação de riscos de clientes.  
Atualmente, FTR desenvolve projetos com IA, plataformas de analytics e programas de GRC para gestão, compliance, mitigação de riscos | fraudes. title: Hardware test & verification designer
description:
At TOPIC ( in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer
with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?
“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”
Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems
What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.
Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:
Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.
What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions
This will make you better:
Permanent contract
An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support
This will keep you healthy:
Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
Regular fun, social, and sports events
What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
Proficient in Python (required); experience with Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ is a plus;
Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.
Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.
Diversity & Inclusion
At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Development (fundraiser) officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning. The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.

Between 1 and 3 years of experience.

title: Senior backend engineer (req english)
description:
3thix Remote-First (Global) | Full-Time About 3thix 3thix is a next-generation fintech platform bridging traditional payments with blockchain rails. We power seamless, low-cost, and compliant transfers using stable tokens, smart contracts, and hybrid on/off-ramp infrastructure. Backed by top-tier VCs, we process millions in daily volume and are expanding into new corridors and asset classes.
The Role We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in fintech payment systems, blockchain protocols, and stable token ecosystems (USDC, USDT, EURC, etc.). You’ll design, build, and scale the core transaction engine that routes fiat ↔ crypto, settles on-chain, and ensures regulatory compliance at every step.
What You’ll Do Architect and maintain high-throughput payment orchestration services handling fiat deposits, crypto swaps, stable token mint/burn, and instant settlements. Build reconciliation systems that sync on-chain events (EVM, Solana, Stellar) with off-chain ledgers and banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, SPEI). Implement risk, fraud, and AML controls in real-time transaction pipelines. Design idempotent, event-driven microservices using Kafka / Pulsar and domain-driven patterns. Own blockchain node infrastructure (Geth, Solana RPC, custom indexers) and write secure smart-contract interaction layers. Scale systems to 10k+ TPS with sub-100ms latency for cross-border flows. Collaborate with compliance and product teams to embed KYC/KYT, travel-rule data, and sanction screening. Lead incident response for payment disputes, rollbacks, and chain re-orgs.
Must-Have Skills 5+ years backend engineering in high-scale environments. Production experience in fintech / payments (acquiring, issuing, remittance, or payout systems). Deep blockchain knowledge: EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum) Stable token standards (ERC-20, SPL, CCTP) MEV, gas optimization, and on-chain data indexing (The Graph, Dune, custom subsql) Mastery of Go, Rust, or Type Script/Node.js (we primarily use Go). Event sourcing, CQRS, and distributed transaction patterns. Secure handling of HSMs, key management (KMS, MPC), and cryptographic signing. Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, ELK. Experience with regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOC2, PSD2, Fin CEN travel rule).
Nice-to-Have Built or audited stablecoin issuance/redemption systems. Contributed to open-source blockchain tooling or payment protocols. Worked with layer-2 networks (Optimism, Base, zk Sync) or cross-chain bridges. Familiarity with ISO 20022, Fed Now, or RTP rails.
Tech Stack Core: Go, Rust, Postgre SQL, Redis, Kafka Blockchain: Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers.js, viem, Solana SDK Infra: Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP/AWS, Grafana Tempo Security: Hashi Corp Vault, AWS KMS, Fireblocks MPC
Why Join 3thix Equity in a rocket-ship startup. Unlimited PTO + global off-sites. Top-tier health, dental, and remote workspace stipend. Work directly with ex-Stripe, Circle, and Coinbase engineers. Shape the future of programmable money.

title: Engenheiro(a) de serviços
description:

Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é: Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, Versa Max, Quick Panel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.
Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior backend engineer (req english)
description:
3thix
Remote-First (Global) | Full-Time
About 3thix
3thix is a next-generation fintech platform bridging traditional payments with blockchain rails. We power seamless, low-cost, and compliant transfers using stable tokens, smart contracts, and hybrid on/off-ramp infrastructure. Backed by top-tier VCs, we process millions in daily volume and are expanding into new corridors and asset classes.
The Role
We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in fintech payment systems, blockchain protocols, and stable token ecosystems (USDC, USDT, EURC, etc.). You’ll design, build, and scale the core transaction engine that routes fiat ↔ crypto, settles on-chain, and ensures regulatory compliance at every step.
What You’ll Do
Architect and maintain high-throughput payment orchestration services handling fiat deposits, crypto swaps, stable token mint/burn, and instant settlements.
Build reconciliation systems that sync on-chain events (EVM, Solana, Stellar) with off-chain ledgers and banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, SPEI).
Implement risk, fraud, and AML controls in real-time transaction pipelines.
Design idempotent, event-driven microservices using Kafka / Pulsar and domain-driven patterns.
Own blockchain node infrastructure (Geth, Solana RPC, custom indexers) and write secure smart-contract interaction layers.
Scale systems to 10k+ TPS with sub-100ms latency for cross-border flows.
Collaborate with compliance and product teams to embed KYC/KYT, travel-rule data, and sanction screening.
Lead incident response for payment disputes, rollbacks, and chain re-orgs.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years backend engineering in high-scale environments.
Production experience in fintech / payments (acquiring, issuing, remittance, or payout systems).
Deep blockchain knowledge:
EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum)
Stable token standards (ERC-20, SPL, CCTP)
MEV, gas optimization, and on-chain data indexing (The Graph, Dune, custom subsql)
Mastery of Go, Rust, or Type Script/Node.js (we primarily use Go).
Event sourcing, CQRS, and distributed transaction patterns.
Secure handling of HSMs, key management (KMS, MPC), and cryptographic signing.
Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, ELK.
Experience with regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOC2, PSD2, Fin CEN travel rule).
Nice-to-Have
Built or audited stablecoin issuance/redemption systems.
Contributed to open-source blockchain tooling or payment protocols.
Worked with layer-2 networks (Optimism, Base, zk Sync) or cross-chain bridges.
Familiarity with ISO 20022, Fed Now, or RTP rails.
Tech Stack
Core: Go, Rust, Postgre SQL, Redis, Kafka
Blockchain: Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers.js, viem, Solana SDK
Infra: Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP/AWS, Grafana Tempo
Security: Hashi Corp Vault, AWS KMS, Fireblocks MPC
Why Join 3thix
Equity in a rocket-ship startup.
Unlimited PTO + global off-sites.
Top-tier health, dental, and remote workspace stipend.
Work directly with ex-Stripe, Circle, and Coinbase engineers.
Shape the future of programmable money.

Monitorar cenário regulatório.FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOSFundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOSé fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.No FTR, utilizamos o Direito como uma ferramenta para negócios e mitigação de riscos.Com escritórios no RJ e SP, atuaçãofull servicee multidisciplinar (desde o consultivo ao contencioso), o FTRtem como um dos seus principais pilares a inovação constante e caracteriza-se por uma dinâmica de trabalho extremamente ágil, estrutura horizontal e acesso direto aos sócios, permitindo um crescimento profissional rápido, multidisciplinar e integrado.Há anos, o FTR impulsiona e relaciona-se com diversasstartupse empresas de inovação, para utilizar a inteligência dos dados em otimização de eficiência e mitigação de riscos de clientes.Atualmente, FTR desenvolve projetos com IA, plataformas deanalytics

Apoiar a curadoria do espaço físico junto com time de VM

Paixão por design e arquitetura.
Perfil analítico e familiaridade com CRM (Pipedrive é um diferencial).
Organizado, detalhista e com boa capacidade de delegar responsabilidades.

title: Secretária
description:

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.A OPORTUNIDADE
Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS:
• Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediatoRESPONSABILIDADES:

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedadePOR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?
• Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientesINFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
• Regime de Contratação: CLT • Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE. RJ • Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)
. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefíciosCOMO SE CANDIDATAR

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Canada.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Operations manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.
Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.
Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.
Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.
Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.
Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.
Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.
Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.
Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.
Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudanças de locatários e movimentações estratégicas de lojistas, discussões contratuais, etc) através de reuniões com os lojistas buscando garantir o planejamento anual do Shopping e atingimento do resultado esperado pelos empreendedores;
Gestão jurídica contratual e ações relacionadas ao empreendimento;
Contribuir com a elaboração e principalmente execução do planejamento estratégico e orçamento plurianual do Shopping por meio de participação em comitês comerciais semanais e demais rotinas junto ao time de Analistas, Assistentes, Estagiário e Auxiliares;
Garantir a veracidade das informações e todos os KPIS da área comercial, que auxiliarão na tomada de decisão do Shopping através da consolidação e análise de relatórios gerenciais;
Maximizar os recursos disponíveis com o objetivo de rentabilizar todas as linhas de receita do empreendimento, principalmente as linhas ligadas aos resultados, assim como na otimização dos custos;
Realizar a gestão de pessoas do time.

Vem ser Concremat!
Estamos em busca de pessoas para atuar como Coordenador de Contratos de Meio Ambiente
Requisitos da Vaga:
Formação em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Civil ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em coordenação de contratos e projetos na área ambiental.
Conhecimento em licenciamento ambiental, normas ambientais e sistemas de gestão ambiental.
Habilidade em gestão de equipes, logística de campo e elaboração/revisão de documentos técnicos.
Proatividade, organização e capacidade de gerenciamento de prazos.
Atribuições e Responsabilidades
1. Planejamento de Atividades
Elaborar e acompanhar planos de trabalho, cronogramas e escopos técnicos para a execução de contratos de projetos ambientais (ex.: licenciamento, recuperação de áreas e monitoramentos ambientais).
Definir metas, prazos e alocação de recursos técnicos e humanos, conforme as exigências contratuais.
Identificar e planejar ações preventivas e corretivas para mitigar riscos contratuais. 2. Organização de Logística de Campo
Coordenar a mobilização e desmobilização de equipes e equipamentos para atividades em campo (amostragem, monitoramento, supervisão de obras ambientais).
Garantir que todos os recursos necessários (material, equipamentos, EPIs, documentação) estejam disponíveis e conforme as normas de segurança e meio ambiente.
Organizar e supervisionar o deslocamento, hospedagem e alimentação da equipe em locais de difícil acesso ou remotos. 3. Revisão Técnica de Documentos
Revisar e validar tecnicamente relatórios, projetos, planos e laudos ambientais, assegurando qualidade e conformidade com a legislação e normas aplicáveis (CONAMA, ABNT, licenças etc.).
Analisar e aprovar documentos técnicos, garantindo alinhamento com o escopo contratado, normas ambientais vigentes e melhores práticas do mercado.
Verificar a adequação de termos, memorial descritivo e estudos ambientais para submissão a órgãos competentes e clientes. 4. Acompanhamento e Gestão de Contratos
Acompanhar o desempenho dos contratos, verificando o cumprimento de prazos, custos e especificações técnicas.
Mediar a comunicação entre a equipe técnica, jurídica, clientes e fornecedores para resolver pendências e assegurar o entendimento comum.
Identificar e reportar desvios, propondo ajustes no escopo, cronograma ou recursos para manter a viabilidade do contrato.
Analisar e aprovar documentos contratuais, aditivos e propostas técnicas, garantindo alinhamento com o escopo, orçamento e metas do projeto. 5. Controle de Qualidade e Conformidade
Garantir que todas as atividades e entregas estejam em conformidade com as políticas ambientais da empresa, normas regulatórias e requisitos do cliente.
Realizar vistorias e auditorias técnicas para verificar a aplicação de boas práticas ambientais e de segurança.
Manter registro e organização de toda a documentação técnica, contratual e de campo para fins de auditoria e prestação de contas.
Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro / RJ
Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido
A Concremat acredita que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação e melhora nossos produtos e serviços. Promover a equidade e a inclusão gera novas ideias e contribui para uma sociedade mais justa. Nosso compromisso com as pessoas reflete diretamente na satisfação dos colaboradores, resultando em uma nota de 4,3 no Glassdoor.

title: Coordenador de projeto ambiental

Nosso compromisso é fortalecer o desenvolvimento regional, promovendo conexões estratégicas entre diferentes mercados e culturas, sempre com foco na excelência e na responsabilidade socioambiental.Se você busca desafios globais, inovação contínua e um ambiente colaborativo, a Concremat é o lugar certo para você. Aqui, cada profissional faz parte de um ecossistema que transforma realidades e impulsiona o futuro. Venha construir esse legado conosco!Vem ser Concremat!Estamos em busca de pessoas para atuar comoCoordenador de Contratos de Meio AmbienteRequisitos da Vaga:
Formação em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Civil ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em coordenação de contratos e projetos na área ambiental.
Conhecimento em licenciamento ambiental, normas ambientais e sistemas de gestão ambiental.
Habilidade em gestão de equipes, logística de campo e elaboração/revisão de documentos técnicos.
Proatividade, organização e capacidade de gerenciamento de prazos.Atribuições e Responsabilidades
1. Planejamento de Atividades
Elaborar e acompanhar planos de trabalho, cronogramas e escopos técnicos para a execução de contratos de projetos ambientais (ex.: licenciamento, recuperação de áreas e monitoramentos ambientais).
Definir metas, prazos e alocação de recursos técnicos e humanos, conforme as exigências contratuais.
Identificar e planejar ações preventivas e corretivas para mitigar riscos contratuais.
2. Organização de Logística de Campo
Coordenar a mobilização e desmobilização de equipes e equipamentos para atividades em campo (amostragem, monitoramento, supervisão de obras ambientais).
Garantir que todos os recursos necessários (material, equipamentos, EPIs, documentação) estejam disponíveis e conforme as normas de segurança e meio ambiente.
Organizar e supervisionar o deslocamento, hospedagem e alimentação da equipe em locais de difícil acesso ou remotos.
3. Revisão Técnica de Documentos
Revisar e validar tecnicamente relatórios, projetos, planos e laudos ambientais, assegurando qualidade e conformidade com a legislação e normas aplicáveis (CONAMA, ABNT, licenças etc.).
Analisar e aprovar documentos técnicos, garantindo alinhamento com o escopo contratado, normas ambientais vigentes e melhores práticas do mercado.
Verificar a adequação de termos, memorial descritivo e estudos ambientais para submissão a órgãos competentes e clientes.
4. Acompanhamento e Gestão de Contratos
Acompanhar o desempenho dos contratos, verificando o cumprimento de prazos, custos e especificações técnicas.
Mediar a comunicação entre a equipe técnica, jurídica, clientes e fornecedores para resolver pendências e assegurar o entendimento comum.
Identificar e reportar desvios, propondo ajustes no escopo, cronograma ou recursos para manter a viabilidade do contrato.
Analisar e aprovar documentos contratuais, aditivos e propostas técnicas, garantindo alinhamento com o escopo, orçamento e metas do projeto.
5. Controle de Qualidade e Conformidade
Garantir que todas as atividades e entregas estejam em conformidade com as políticas ambientais da empresa, normas regulatórias e requisitos do cliente.
Realizar vistorias e auditorias técnicas para verificar a aplicação de boas práticas ambientais e de segurança.
Manter registro e organização de toda a documentação técnica, contratual e de campo para fins de auditoria e prestação de contas.Local de Trabalho:Rio de Janeiro / RJ
Modelo de trabalho:HíbridoA Concrematacredita que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação e melhora nossos produtos e serviços. Promover a equidade e a inclusão gera novas ideias e contribui para uma sociedade mais justa. Nosso compromisso com as pessoas reflete diretamente na satisfação dos colaboradores,resultando em uma nota de 4,3 no Glassdoor.Buscamos criar um ambiente onde todos possam ser autênticos, valorizados por seu talento e potencial. Por isso, incentivamos candidaturas de diferentes gêneros, raças, religiões, idades, orientações sexuais, nacionalidades e pessoas com deficiência.Se você acredita no seu potencial, candidate-se, mesmo que não atenda a todos os requisitos.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudanças de locatários e movimentações estratégicas de lojistas, discussões contratuais, etc) através de reuniões com os lojistas buscando garantir o planejamento anual do Shopping e atingimento do resultado esperado pelos empreendedores;
Gestão jurídica contratual e ações relacionadas ao empreendimento;
Contribuir com a elaboração e principalmente execução do planejamento estratégico e orçamento plurianual do Shopping por meio de participação em comitês comerciais semanais e demais rotinas junto ao time de Analistas, Assistentes, Estagiário e Auxiliares;
Garantir a veracidade das informações e todos os KPIS da área comercial, que auxiliarão na tomada de decisão do Shopping através da consolidação e análise de relatórios gerenciais;
Maximizar os recursos disponíveis com o objetivo de rentabilizar todas as linhas de receita do empreendimento, principalmente as linhas ligadas aos resultados, assim como na otimização dos custos;
Realizar a gestão de pessoas do time.Requisitos e qualificações:

Vivência em negociação comercial;

title: Operations manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.Personal Attributes
Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.Additional Information:
This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.Travel
Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.HSE Awareness:
All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high e NPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.Apply nowand become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Sales executive - shipyards & shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners
Department: Sales
Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M& O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.
The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M& O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Solution Representation
Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards. Business Development
Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
Expand M& O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction. Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions. Sales Strategy & Reporting
Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M& O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.
Skills and Competencies B2 B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales. Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams. Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance. Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes. Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.
Experience Requirements 2 to 5 years of experience in B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors. Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers . Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects. Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!
